Services and prices

Every job starts with a standard mow, priced by lawn size. Add what your lawn needs, pay per visit or by the month, and see the price before you book.

The standard mow

Included in every quote, and exactly what the price bands pay for.

  • Front and back lawns cut clean and even
  • Clippings mulched, or caught and put in your green bin — your call
  • Paths and driveway blown clear
  • Trimming around trees, beds and obstacles
  • A message when we're on the way and when we're done, with before-and-after photos

Optional add-ons

Not included in the standard mow. Tick them on the quote form and we'll confirm the exact figure before you book.

  • Edging and whipper snip +$18–28 Crisp edges along paths, driveways, fences and garden beds where the mower can't reach.
  • Hedge trimming Intro rate Ask Light shaping, not removal or stump work. Discounted while we build up hedging experience, priced per job by size and how overgrown it is.
  • Green waste removal +$18–28 Only if you don't have your own green waste bin. Otherwise the clippings go in yours at no extra charge.

Add-on prices are typical Melbourne rates. The exact figure is confirmed with your mow price.

Two ways to pay

A one-off mow priced by lawn size, or a flat monthly subscription. Both cover a standard mow; add-ons and hard-to-reach sites are quoted on top.

Common questions

Do I need to be home?

Not if there's street or side-gate access straight to the lawn — just leave a gate code or access notes on the quote form. If getting to the lawn means going through your garage or the house, you'll need to be home (or arrange access). Mention it when you request your quote so it's not a surprise on the day.

What happens to the clippings?

They go in your own green waste bin at no extra charge. If you don't have one, we can bag them and take them away for $18–28.

What if it's raining on the day?

Light rain is fine. For genuinely wet ground or a storm, we'll message you to reschedule — no fee for that.

How do I pay?

Bank transfer. A deposit of $20 or 20% of the quoted price, whichever is higher, confirms your booking within 24 hours of accepting the quote. The rest is due on the day.

What if I'm not happy with the job?

Let us know within 24 hours of the mow and we'll make it right — usually by coming back to fix whatever's wrong. We don't offer refunds, but we won't leave a job half-done either.

Can I cancel the monthly subscription?

Yes, anytime — there is no lock-in contract. Just let us know before the next scheduled visit.
